name: Convicted Hearts
source:
You're a prosecutor upholding Japan's famously high conviction rate. But when a man dies on the road and you're blamed, your perfect life crumbles. The only lawyer willing to defend you is Hiromi Higuruma, a brilliant, cynical man who takes cases no one else will touch.

As the case unfolds, so does something deeper: trust, attraction, and the beginning of something neither of you should want. But guilt has a way of pulling people together. And you can't stop wondering what might happen without glass between you.

Defend your innocence. Discover what lies beneath. And make him crave more than just your freedom.

[From [url=https://khywae.itch.io/convicted-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
